body_html:
The Danio armless task stool brings true desk-chair ergonomics to standing-height work. With a generous 23"–33" pneumatic height range, a task mechanism with seat-depth adjustment, and a height-adjustable chrome footrest, it keeps staff supported whether they're perched at a lab bench, a reception counter, or a standing workstation. Thick foam cushioning and decorative stitch detailing give it a finished, professional look that holds up in high-traffic institutional settings.

Features

  • Task mechanism with seat-depth adjustment for personalized support
  • Pneumatic seat height adjustment with a wide 23"–33" range
  • Height-adjustable hinged back with a scuff-resistant outer shroud
  • Thick foam cushioning with decorative stitch detailing
  • Height-adjustable chrome circular footrest
  • Dual-wheel casters for easy repositioning
  • Optional height-adjustable T-arms available (model MVL2784)
  • Upholster in any Global Grade 1 seating textile (excludes Luxhide)

Specifications

Overall dimensions 24"W x 22.5"D x 43"H with a 23"–33" seat-height range; rated to 300 lbs. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and certified BIFMA LEVEL and GREENGUARD Gold for low-emission, sustainable workspaces.

A Canadian-made stool from a family-owned dealer serving institutions since 1964. Office Central is an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario school boards, hospitals, and municipalities can purchase without an open tender.
